```lean filename=formal_oet/vol_01/ch_02_operator_bounds/operator_bounds.lean
import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Mul
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.operator_space

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

/-- An extended nonnegative bound matrix.  The first index is the output
component (the row), and the second index is the input component (the column).
Thus `L j i` represents the source entry `L_{i → j}`. -/
abbrev BoundMatrix (I : Type) := Matrix I I ENNReal

/-- Matrix multiplication in output-row/input-column coordinates. -/
theorem boundMatrix_mul_channel_apply {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (M N : BoundMatrix I) (i j : I) :
    (M * N) j i = ∑ k, M j k * N k i := by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]

/-- `L` is a Lipschitz certificate for `φ` restricted to `U`.
The domain condition is part of restricted-certificate validity. -/
def IsRestrictedLipMatrix {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (L : BoundMatrix I) : Prop :=
  U ⊆ dom φ ∧
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j,
      d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y) ≤ ∑ i, L j i * d i x y

/-- `L` is a global Lipschitz certificate: the restricted predicate on
`dom φ`. -/
def IsLipMatrix {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot)
    (L : BoundMatrix I) : Prop :=
  IsRestrictedLipMatrix d φ (dom φ) L

/-- The family of all global Lipschitz certificates for `φ`. -/
def lipCertificates {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) : Set (BoundMatrix I) :=
  {L | IsLipMatrix d φ L}

/-- The family of all Lipschitz certificates for `φ` restricted to `U`. -/
def restrictedLipCertificates {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) : Set (BoundMatrix I) :=
  {L | IsRestrictedLipMatrix d φ U L}

/-- The global predicate expands to exactly the displayed family of
Lipschitz inequalities on `dom φ`. -/
theorem isLipMatrix_iff {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (L : BoundMatrix I) :
    IsLipMatrix d φ L ↔
      ∀ x ∈ dom φ, ∀ y ∈ dom φ, ∀ j,
        d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y) ≤ ∑ i, L j i * d i x y := by
  simp [IsLipMatrix, IsRestrictedLipMatrix]

/-- A co-Lipschitz certificate on `U`.  Both `U ⊆ dom φ` and the source's
standing nonemptiness requirement `U ≠ ∅` are included in validity. -/
def IsRestrictedCoLipMatrix {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (K : BoundMatrix I) : Prop :=
  U.Nonempty ∧ U ⊆ dom φ ∧
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j,
      ∑ i, K j i * d i x y ≤ d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y)

/-- The family of all co-Lipschitz certificates for `φ` restricted to `U`;
membership includes the requirement that `U` be nonempty. -/
def restrictedCoLipCertificates {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) : Set (BoundMatrix I) :=
  {K | IsRestrictedCoLipMatrix d φ U K}

/-- A component channel, viewed as an ordered pair with separately named
input and output components. -/
structure ComponentChannel (I : Type) where
  input : I
  output : I

/-- The matrix coefficient attached to a component channel. -/
def channelEntry {I : Type} (L : BoundMatrix I) (c : ComponentChannel I) : ENNReal :=
  L c.output c.input

/-- In output row `j`, only input column `i` is allowed to be nonzero. -/
def SingleInputRow {I : Type} (L : BoundMatrix I) (i j : I) : Prop :=
  ∀ k, k ≠ i → L j k = 0

/-- A bound matrix is diagonal when every off-diagonal channel entry is zero. -/
def IsDiagonalBoundMatrix {I : Type} (L : BoundMatrix I) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, i ≠ j → L j i = 0

/-- Every diagonal output row has only its same-component input term. -/
theorem diagonal_singleInputRow {I : Type} (L : BoundMatrix I)
    (hL : IsDiagonalBoundMatrix L) (i : I) :
    SingleInputRow L i i := by
  intro k hki
  exact hL k i hki

/-- With only one potentially nonzero input term in an output row, the whole
weighted sum simplifies to that term. -/
theorem weighted_row_eq_single_input {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (L : BoundMatrix I) (v : I → ENNReal) (i j : I)
    (hrow : SingleInputRow L i j) :
    ∑ k, L j k * v k = L j i * v i := by
  classical
  refine Finset.sum_eq_single i ?_ ?_
  · intro k _ hki
    rw [hrow k hki, zero_mul]
  · simp

/-- Proposition: a single-input output row reduces the restricted Lipschitz
inequality to the corresponding scalar upper bound. -/
theorem lip_bound_of_singleInputRow {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (L : BoundMatrix I)
    (hL : L ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d φ U)
    {i j : I} (hrow : SingleInputRow L i j)
    {x y : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y) ≤ L j i * d i x y := by
  calc
    d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y) ≤ ∑ k, L j k * d k x y := hL.2 x hx y hy j
    _ = L j i * d i x y := weighted_row_eq_single_input L (fun k => d k x y) i j hrow

/-- Diagonal special case: every same-component channel has the scalar
Lipschitz upper bound. -/
theorem lip_bound_of_diagonal {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (L : BoundMatrix I)
    (hL : L ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d φ U)
    (hdiag : IsDiagonalBoundMatrix L)
    {x y : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) (i : I) :
    d i (φ.func x) (φ.func y) ≤ L i i * d i x y := by
  exact lip_bound_of_singleInputRow d φ U L hL
    (diagonal_singleInputRow L hdiag i) hx hy

/-- One input term is already bounded above by the output distance whenever
`K` is a restricted co-Lipschitz certificate. -/
theorem coLip_single_input_le {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (K : BoundMatrix I)
    (hK : K ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d φ U)
    {x y : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) (i j : I) :
    K j i * d i x y ≤ d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y) := by
  calc
    K j i * d i x y ≤ ∑ k, K j k * d k x y := by
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => zero_le (K j k * d k x y))
        (Finset.mem_univ i)
    _ ≤ d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y) := hK.2.2 x hx y hy j

/-- Proposition 2.8(i): a strictly positive co-Lipschitz channel carries
strictly positive input distance to strictly positive output distance. -/
theorem positive_output_dist_of_positive_coLip {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (K : BoundMatrix I)
    (hK : K ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d φ U)
    {i j : I} (hKij : 0 < K j i)
    {x y : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hd : 0 < d i x y) :
    0 < d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y) := by
  have hterm : 0 < K j i * d i x y :=
    ENNReal.mul_pos (ne_of_gt hKij) (ne_of_gt hd)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hterm (coLip_single_input_le d φ U K hK hx hy i j)

/-- Proposition 2.8(ii): if every diagonal co-Lipschitz entry is strictly
positive, then `φ` reflects the family's zero-distance relation on `U`.
The conclusion is `GaugeZeroRelated`, not point equality. -/
theorem reflects_gaugeZeroRelated_of_positive_diagonal_coLip
    {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (K : BoundMatrix I)
    (hK : K ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d φ U)
    (hdiag : ∀ j, 0 < K j j)
    {x y : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hzero : GaugeZeroRelated d (φ.func x) (φ.func y)) :
    GaugeZeroRelated d x y := by
  intro j
  by_contra hne
  have hd : 0 < d j x y := pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne
  have himage : 0 < d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y) :=
    positive_output_dist_of_positive_coLip d φ U K hK (hdiag j) hx hy hd
  rw [hzero j] at himage
  exact lt_irrefl 0 himage

/-- Exercise 2.2: with only the diagonal input term in the Lipschitz row,
the output distance has the stated scalar two-sided bound. -/
theorem scalar_two_sided_bound_of_diagonal_input_row
    {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (L K : BoundMatrix I)
    (hL : L ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d φ U)
    (hK : K ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d φ U)
    {j : I} (hrow : ∀ k, k ≠ j → L j k = 0)
    {x y : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    K j j * d j x y ≤ d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y) ∧
      d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y) ≤ L j j * d j x y := by
  constructor
  · exact coLip_single_input_le d φ U K hK hx hy j j
  · exact lip_bound_of_singleInputRow d φ U L hL hrow hx hy

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
```

```lean filename=OperatorBounds.lean
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.operator_space
import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Mul
import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Diagonal
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.BigOperators.Group.Finset
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Operator bounds

This file formalizes the selected definitions and results from Chapter 2.
Matrices use the textbook convention: rows are output components and columns
are input components.  Thus `channelEntry L i j` is the entry `L_{i → j}`.
-/

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open scoped BigOperators Classical

/-- An extended nonnegative matrix on the component index set. -/
abbrev ChannelMatrix (I : Type) := Matrix I I ENNReal

/-- The coefficient of input channel `i` in output channel `j`.
This is row `j`, column `i` of the underlying matrix. -/
def channelEntry {I : Type} (L : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I) : ENNReal := L j i

@[simp] theorem channelEntry_apply {I : Type} (L : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I) :
    channelEntry L i j = L j i := rfl

/-- Expansion of ordinary matrix multiplication in channel notation. -/
theorem channelEntry_mul {I : Type} [Fintype I] (A B : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I) :
    channelEntry (A * B) i j = ∑ k : I, channelEntry A k j * channelEntry B i k := by
  rfl

/-- The unit matrix has exactly the diagonal unit channels. -/
theorem channelEntry_one {I : Type} [DecidableEq I] (i j : I) :
    channelEntry (1 : ChannelMatrix I) i j = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [channelEntry, Matrix.one_apply]
  · have h' : j ≠ i := Ne.symm h
    simp [channelEntry, Matrix.one_apply, h, h']

/-- Ordered product for matrices listed in their order of application.
For example, `orderedMatrixProduct [M₁, M₂, M₃] = M₃ * M₂ * M₁`.
The empty product is the unit matrix. -/
noncomputable def orderedMatrixProduct {I : Type} [Fintype I] : List (ChannelMatrix I) → ChannelMatrix I
  | [] => 1
  | M :: Ms => orderedMatrixProduct Ms * M

@[simp] theorem orderedMatrixProduct_nil {I : Type} [Fintype I] :
    orderedMatrixProduct ([] : List (ChannelMatrix I)) = 1 := rfl

@[simp] theorem orderedMatrixProduct_cons {I : Type} [Fintype I] (M : ChannelMatrix I)
    (Ms : List (ChannelMatrix I)) :
    orderedMatrixProduct (M :: Ms) = orderedMatrixProduct Ms * M := rfl

@[simp] theorem orderedMatrixProduct_singleton {I : Type} [Fintype I] (M : ChannelMatrix I) :
    orderedMatrixProduct [M] = M := by
  simp

/-- Restricted Lipschitz matrices.  The domain restriction is part of the
certificate, exactly as in the definition of `mathscr L(φ)|_U`. -/
def IsRestrictedLipMatrix {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L : ChannelMatrix I) : Prop :=
  U ⊆ dom φ ∧
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y) ≤ ∑ i : I, channelEntry L i j * d i x y

/-- Global Lipschitz matrices are restricted to the whole domain. -/
def IsGlobalLipMatrix {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (L : ChannelMatrix I) : Prop :=
  IsRestrictedLipMatrix d φ (dom φ) L

/-- The family of restricted Lipschitz certificates. -/
def lipCertificates {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) :
    Set (ChannelMatrix I) := {L | IsRestrictedLipMatrix d φ U L}

/-- The family of global Lipschitz certificates. -/
def globalLipCertificates {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) : Set (ChannelMatrix I) :=
  {L | IsGlobalLipMatrix d φ L}

/-- Restricted co-Lipschitz matrices.  Both `U ⊆ dom φ` and `U.Nonempty`
are part of the certificate predicate. -/
def IsRestrictedCoLipMatrix {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (K : ChannelMatrix I) : Prop :=
  U.Nonempty ∧ U ⊆ dom φ ∧
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      ∑ i : I, channelEntry K i j * d i x y ≤ d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y)

/-- Global co-Lipschitz matrices; in particular, the domain is nonempty. -/
def IsGlobalCoLipMatrix {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (K : ChannelMatrix I) : Prop :=
  IsRestrictedCoLipMatrix d φ (dom φ) K

/-- The family of restricted co-Lipschitz certificates. -/
def coLipCertificates {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) :
    Set (ChannelMatrix I) := {K | IsRestrictedCoLipMatrix d φ U K}

/-- The family of global co-Lipschitz certificates. -/
def globalCoLipCertificates {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) : Set (ChannelMatrix I) :=
  {K | IsGlobalCoLipMatrix d φ K}

/-- Finite composition in order of application: `[φ₁, φ₂, …, φₖ]`
represents `φₖ ∘ … ∘ φ₂ ∘ φ₁`; the empty list represents the identity. -/
def finiteComposition {X : Type} {bot : X} : List (Operator X bot) → Operator X bot
  | [] => operator_identity
  | φ :: φs => operator_compose (finiteComposition φs) φ

@[simp] theorem finiteComposition_nil {X : Type} {bot : X} :
    finiteComposition ([] : List (Operator X bot)) = operator_identity := rfl

@[simp] theorem finiteComposition_cons {X : Type} {bot : X} (φ : Operator X bot)
    (φs : List (Operator X bot)) :
    finiteComposition (φ :: φs) = operator_compose (finiteComposition φs) φ := rfl

@[simp] theorem finiteComposition_singleton {X : Type} {bot : X} (φ : Operator X bot) :
    finiteComposition [φ] = φ := rfl

/-- The chronological-list representation agrees with the frozen
`OperatorChain` implementation after reversing the list. -/
theorem finiteComposition_eq_operatorChain_reverse {X : Type} {bot : X}
    (φs : List (Operator X bot)) :
    finiteComposition φs = OperatorChain φs.reverse := by
  rw [operator_chain_eq_prod]
  induction φs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons φ φs ih =>
      change operator_compose (finiteComposition φs) φ = (φ :: φs).reverse.prod
      rw [List.reverse_cons, List.prod_append]
      change finiteComposition φs * φ = φs.reverse.prod * [φ].prod
      rw [ih]
      rfl

/-- The actual intermediate image sets `U₁, …, Uₖ, Uₖ₊₁`. -/
def intermediateImages {X : Type} {bot : X} :
    List (Operator X bot) → Set X → List (Set X)
  | [], U => [U]
  | φ :: φs, U => U :: intermediateImages φs (φ.func '' U)

@[simp] theorem intermediateImages_nil {X : Type} {bot : X} (U : Set X) :
    intermediateImages ([] : List (Operator X bot)) U = [U] := rfl

@[simp] theorem intermediateImages_cons {X : Type} {bot : X} (φ : Operator X bot)
    (φs : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X) :
    intermediateImages (φ :: φs) U = U :: intermediateImages φs (φ.func '' U) := rfl

/-- There are `k + 1` actual image sets for a chain of length `k`. -/
theorem intermediateImages_length {X : Type} {bot : X}
    (φs : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X) :
    (intermediateImages φs U).length = φs.length + 1 := by
  induction φs generalizing U with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons φ φs ih =>
      simp only [intermediateImages_cons, List.length_cons, List.length]
      rw [ih]

/-- Stepwise Lip certificates, indexed recursively by the actual image sets. -/
def StepwiseLipCertificates {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) :
    (φs : List (Operator X bot)) → List (ChannelMatrix I) → Set X → Prop
  | [], [], _ => True
  | φ :: φs, L :: Ls, U =>
      IsRestrictedLipMatrix d φ U L ∧
        StepwiseLipCertificates d φs Ls (φ.func '' U)
  | _, _, _ => False

/-- Stepwise co-Lip certificates on the same actual image sets. -/
def StepwiseCoLipCertificates {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) :
    (φs : List (Operator X bot)) → List (ChannelMatrix I) → Set X → Prop
  | [], [], _ => True
  | φ :: φs, K :: Ks, U =>
      IsRestrictedCoLipMatrix d φ U K ∧
        StepwiseCoLipCertificates d φs Ks (φ.func '' U)
  | _, _, _ => False

/-- Passing to the image of the initial set leaves a subset of the domain
of the remaining composition. -/
theorem image_subset_dom_finiteComposition_tail {X : Type} {bot : X}
    (φ : Operator X bot) (φs : List (Operator X bot)) {U : Set X}
    (hU : U ⊆ dom (finiteComposition (φ :: φs))) :
    φ.func '' U ⊆ dom (finiteComposition φs) := by
  rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact hU hx

/-- A one-component sum is the corresponding scalar channel bound. -/
theorem unique_sum_channelEntry {I : Type} [Fintype I] [Unique I]
    (L : ChannelMatrix I) (f : I → ENNReal) :
    (∑ i : I, channelEntry L i default * f i) =
      channelEntry L default default * f default := by
  exact Fintype.sum_unique _

/-- On a singleton component index type, the restricted Lip condition is
exactly the displayed scalar inequality (together with its domain condition). -/
theorem isRestrictedLipMatrix_unique_iff {X I : Type} {bot : X}
    [Fintype I] [Unique I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L : ChannelMatrix I) :
    IsRestrictedLipMatrix d φ U L ↔
      U ⊆ dom φ ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
        d default (φ.func x) (φ.func y) ≤
          channelEntry L default default * d default x y := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hU, hL⟩
    refine ⟨hU, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    simpa only [unique_sum_channelEntry] using hL x hx y hy default
  · rintro ⟨hU, hL⟩
    refine ⟨hU, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy j
    have hj : j = default := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst j
    simpa only [unique_sum_channelEntry] using hL x hx y hy

/-- Global form of the one-component scalar simplification. -/
theorem isGlobalLipMatrix_unique_iff {X I : Type} {bot : X}
    [Fintype I] [Unique I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (L : ChannelMatrix I) :
    IsGlobalLipMatrix d φ L ↔ ∀ x ∈ dom φ, ∀ y ∈ dom φ,
      d default (φ.func x) (φ.func y) ≤
        channelEntry L default default * d default x y := by
  change IsRestrictedLipMatrix d φ (dom φ) L ↔ _
  rw [isRestrictedLipMatrix_unique_iff]
  simp

/-- Restricted Lip certificate families are reverse monotone in the domain. -/
theorem lipCertificates_antitone {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) {U V : Set X}
    (hUV : U ⊆ V) (hV : V ⊆ dom φ) :
    lipCertificates d φ V ⊆ lipCertificates d φ U := by
  intro L hL
  refine ⟨hUV.trans hV, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  exact hL.2 x (hUV hx) y (hUV hy) j

/-- Every global Lip certificate restricts to any subset of the domain. -/
theorem globalLip_mem_lipCertificates {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) {U : Set X}
    (hU : U ⊆ dom φ) {L : ChannelMatrix I}
    (hL : L ∈ globalLipCertificates d φ) :
    L ∈ lipCertificates d φ U := by
  exact lipCertificates_antitone d φ hU (fun _ h => h) hL

/-- Restricted co-Lip certificate families are reverse monotone, with the
nonemptiness of the smaller set retained. -/
theorem coLipCertificates_antitone {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) {U V : Set X}
    (hUne : U.Nonempty) (hUV : U ⊆ V) (hV : V ⊆ dom φ) :
    coLipCertificates d φ V ⊆ coLipCertificates d φ U := by
  intro K hK
  refine ⟨hUne, hUV.trans hV, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  exact hK.2.2 x (hUV hx) y (hUV hy) j

/-- Every global co-Lip certificate restricts to a nonempty domain subset. -/
theorem globalCoLip_mem_coLipCertificates {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) {U : Set X}
    (hUne : U.Nonempty) (hU : U ⊆ dom φ) {K : ChannelMatrix I}
    (hK : K ∈ globalCoLipCertificates d φ) :
    K ∈ coLipCertificates d φ U := by
  exact coLipCertificates_antitone d φ hUne hU (fun _ h => h) hK

/-- Algebra behind both two-step composition laws. -/
theorem sum_channelEntry_mul {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (A B : ChannelMatrix I) (j : I) (f : I → ENNReal) :
    (∑ i : I, channelEntry (A * B) i j * f i) =
      ∑ k : I, channelEntry A k j * (∑ i : I, channelEntry B i k * f i) := by
  simp_rw [channelEntry_mul, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

/-- Two-step Lip composition, with the exact intermediate image domain and
with `L₂ * L₁` in the stated order. -/
theorem lip_compose_two {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ₂ φ₁ : Operator X bot) {U : Set X}
    (hU : U ⊆ dom (operator_compose φ₂ φ₁)) {L₁ L₂ : ChannelMatrix I}
    (h₁ : L₁ ∈ lipCertificates d φ₁ U)
    (h₂ : L₂ ∈ lipCertificates d φ₂ (φ₁.func '' U)) :
    L₂ * L₁ ∈ lipCertificates d (operator_compose φ₂ φ₁) U := by
  refine ⟨hU, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  calc
    d j ((operator_compose φ₂ φ₁).func x) ((operator_compose φ₂ φ₁).func y)
        ≤ ∑ k : I, channelEntry L₂ k j * d k (φ₁.func x) (φ₁.func y) :=
      h₂.2 (φ₁.func x) ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ (φ₁.func y) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ j
    _ ≤ ∑ k : I, channelEntry L₂ k j *
          (∑ i : I, channelEntry L₁ i k * d i x y) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ =>
        mul_le_mul_left' (h₁.2 x hx y hy k) (channelEntry L₂ k j)
    _ = ∑ i : I, channelEntry (L₂ * L₁) i j * d i x y := by
      rw [sum_channelEntry_mul]

/-- Two-step co-Lip composition, retaining nonemptiness and the exact
intermediate image domain. -/
theorem coLip_compose_two {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ₂ φ₁ : Operator X bot) {U : Set X}
    (hU : U ⊆ dom (operator_compose φ₂ φ₁)) {K₁ K₂ : ChannelMatrix I}
    (h₁ : K₁ ∈ coLipCertificates d φ₁ U)
    (h₂ : K₂ ∈ coLipCertificates d φ₂ (φ₁.func '' U)) :
    K₂ * K₁ ∈ coLipCertificates d (operator_compose φ₂ φ₁) U := by
  refine ⟨h₁.1, hU, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  calc
    (∑ i : I, channelEntry (K₂ * K₁) i j * d i x y) =
        ∑ k : I, channelEntry K₂ k j *
          (∑ i : I, channelEntry K₁ i k * d i x y) := sum_channelEntry_mul _ _ _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ k : I, channelEntry K₂ k j * d k (φ₁.func x) (φ₁.func y) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ =>
        mul_le_mul_left' (h₁.2.2 x hx y hy k) (channelEntry K₂ k j)
    _ ≤ d j ((operator_compose φ₂ φ₁).func x) ((operator_compose φ₂ φ₁).func y) :=
      h₂.2.2 (φ₁.func x) ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ (φ₁.func y) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ j

/-- A zero output distance together with a positive input distance forces
the corresponding entry of every global co-Lip certificate to vanish. -/
theorem channelEntry_eq_zero_of_output_zero_input_pos {X I : Type} {bot : X}
    [Fintype I] (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot)
    {K : ChannelMatrix I} (hK : K ∈ globalCoLipCertificates d φ)
    {x y : X} (hx : x ∈ dom φ) (hy : y ∈ dom φ) {i j : I}
    (hout : d j (φ.func x) (φ.func y) = 0) (hin : 0 < d i x y) :
    channelEntry K i j = 0 := by
  have hterm : channelEntry K i j * d i x y ≤
      ∑ k : I, channelEntry K k j * d k x y := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => zero_le (channelEntry K k j * d k x y))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hbound := hK.2.2 x hx y hy j
  rw [hout] at hbound
  have hz : channelEntry K i j * d i x y = 0 :=
    le_antisymm (hterm.trans hbound) (zero_le _)
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with hKi | hdi
  · exact hKi
  · exact (ne_of_gt hin hdi).elim

/-- The unit matrix collapses a channel sum to its diagonal term. -/
theorem sum_channelEntry_one {I : Type} [Fintype I] (f : I → ENNReal) (j : I) :
    (∑ i : I, channelEntry (1 : ChannelMatrix I) i j * f i) = f j := by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ i : I, channelEntry (1 : ChannelMatrix I) i j * f i) =
        ∑ i : I, if i = j then f i else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      by_cases h : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [channelEntry, Matrix.one_apply]
      · have h' : j ≠ i := Ne.symm h
        simp [channelEntry, Matrix.one_apply, h, h']
    _ = f j := by simp

/-- Zero-step composition: the empty ordered matrix product is a Lip
certificate for the identity operator. -/
theorem zeroStep_identity_lip {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) {U : Set X} (hUne : U.Nonempty)
    (hU : U ⊆ dom (finiteComposition ([] : List (Operator X bot)))) :
    orderedMatrixProduct ([] : List (ChannelMatrix I)) ∈
      lipCertificates d (finiteComposition ([] : List (Operator X bot))) U := by
  refine ⟨hU, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  change d j x y ≤ ∑ i : I, channelEntry (1 : ChannelMatrix I) i j * d i x y
  rw [sum_channelEntry_one]

/-- Zero-step composition: the same empty product/unit matrix is a co-Lip
certificate for the identity operator. -/
theorem zeroStep_identity_coLip {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) {U : Set X} (hUne : U.Nonempty)
    (hU : U ⊆ dom (finiteComposition ([] : List (Operator X bot)))) :
    orderedMatrixProduct ([] : List (ChannelMatrix I)) ∈
      coLipCertificates d (finiteComposition ([] : List (Operator X bot))) U := by
  refine ⟨hUne, hU, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  change (∑ i : I, channelEntry (1 : ChannelMatrix I) i j * d i x y) ≤ d j x y
  rw [sum_channelEntry_one]

/-- The ordered product of stepwise Lip certificates certifies every
nonempty finite composition chain. -/
theorem finiteComposition_lip {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) {φs : List (Operator X bot)}
    (hφs : φs ≠ []) {U : Set X} (hU : U ⊆ dom (finiteComposition φs))
    {Ls : List (ChannelMatrix I)} (hLs : StepwiseLipCertificates d φs Ls U) :
    orderedMatrixProduct Ls ∈ lipCertificates d (finiteComposition φs) U := by
  induction φs generalizing U Ls with
  | nil => exact (hφs rfl).elim
  | cons φ φs ih =>
      cases Ls with
      | nil => exact False.elim hLs
      | cons L Ls =>
          rcases hLs with ⟨hL, hLs⟩
          cases φs with
          | nil =>
              cases Ls with
              | nil => simpa using hL
              | cons L' Ls' => exact False.elim hLs
          | cons ψ ψs =>
              have htailU : φ.func '' U ⊆ dom (finiteComposition (ψ :: ψs)) :=
                image_subset_dom_finiteComposition_tail φ (ψ :: ψs) hU
              have htail : orderedMatrixProduct Ls ∈
                  lipCertificates d (finiteComposition (ψ :: ψs)) (φ.func '' U) :=
                ih (List.cons_ne_nil ψ ψs) htailU hLs
              exact lip_compose_two d (finiteComposition (ψ :: ψs)) φ hU hL htail

/-- The ordered product of stepwise co-Lip certificates certifies every
nonempty finite composition chain. -/
theorem finiteComposition_coLip {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) {φs : List (Operator X bot)}
    (hφs : φs ≠ []) {U : Set X} (hU : U ⊆ dom (finiteComposition φs))
    {Ks : List (ChannelMatrix I)} (hKs : StepwiseCoLipCertificates d φs Ks U) :
    orderedMatrixProduct Ks ∈ coLipCertificates d (finiteComposition φs) U := by
  induction φs generalizing U Ks with
  | nil => exact (hφs rfl).elim
  | cons φ φs ih =>
      cases Ks with
      | nil => exact False.elim hKs
      | cons K Ks =>
          rcases hKs with ⟨hK, hKs⟩
          cases φs with
          | nil =>
              cases Ks with
              | nil => simpa using hK
              | cons K' Ks' => exact False.elim hKs
          | cons ψ ψs =>
              have htailU : φ.func '' U ⊆ dom (finiteComposition (ψ :: ψs)) :=
                image_subset_dom_finiteComposition_tail φ (ψ :: ψs) hU
              have htail : orderedMatrixProduct Ks ∈
                  coLipCertificates d (finiteComposition (ψ :: ψs)) (φ.func '' U) :=
                ih (List.cons_ne_nil ψ ψs) htailU hKs
              exact coLip_compose_two d (finiteComposition (ψ :: ψs)) φ hU hK htail
```

```lean filename=MatrixPaths.lean
import OperatorBounds
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.List

/-!
# Finite matrix products and component-index paths

An index path stores only its intermediate vertices.  For a list of `n`
matrices it has length `n - 1`; in particular the unique path for one matrix
is empty.  Its factors use the same input/output convention as `channelEntry`.
-/

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

open scoped BigOperators Classical

/-- Adjacent directed edges of a vertex list. -/
def adjacentPairs {I : Type} : List I → List (I × I)
  | [] => []
  | [_] => []
  | a :: b :: rest => (a, b) :: adjacentPairs (b :: rest)

/-- The full vertex list determined by endpoints and intermediate vertices. -/
def pathVertices {I : Type} (i j : I) (p : List I) : List I := i :: (p ++ [j])

/-- The channel entries along a path, in order of application. -/
def pathFactors {I : Type} (Ms : List (ChannelMatrix I)) (i j : I) (p : List I) :
    List ENNReal :=
  List.zipWith (fun M e => channelEntry M e.1 e.2) Ms
    (adjacentPairs (pathVertices i j p))

/-- Product of all channel entries along a path. -/
noncomputable def pathWeight {I : Type} (Ms : List (ChannelMatrix I)) (i j : I) (p : List I) : ENNReal :=
  (pathFactors Ms i j p).prod

/-- A finite index path has exactly one fewer intermediate vertex than the
number of matrices. -/
def IsIndexPath {I : Type} (Ms : List (ChannelMatrix I)) (p : List I) : Prop :=
  p.length + 1 = Ms.length

/-- A valid path is all-positive when every one-step entry is strictly positive. -/
def IsAllPositivePath {I : Type} (Ms : List (ChannelMatrix I)) (i j : I) (p : List I) : Prop :=
  IsIndexPath Ms p ∧ ∀ a ∈ pathFactors Ms i j p, 0 < a

@[simp] theorem pathWeight_singleton {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I) :
    pathWeight [M] i j [] = channelEntry M i j := by
  simp [pathWeight, pathFactors, pathVertices, adjacentPairs]

@[simp] theorem pathFactors_singleton {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I) :
    pathFactors [M] i j [] = [channelEntry M i j] := by
  simp [pathFactors, pathVertices, adjacentPairs]

/-- Split the first edge from a path through at least two matrices. -/
theorem pathFactors_cons_two {I : Type} (M N : ChannelMatrix I)
    (Ms : List (ChannelMatrix I)) (i j k : I) (p : List I) :
    pathFactors (M :: N :: Ms) i j (k :: p) =
      channelEntry M i k :: pathFactors (N :: Ms) k j p := by
  simp [pathFactors, pathVertices, adjacentPairs]

/-- Multiplicative form of `pathFactors_cons_two`. -/
theorem pathWeight_cons_two {I : Type} (M N : ChannelMatrix I)
    (Ms : List (ChannelMatrix I)) (i j k : I) (p : List I) :
    pathWeight (M :: N :: Ms) i j (k :: p) =
      channelEntry M i k * pathWeight (N :: Ms) k j p := by
  simp [pathWeight, pathFactors_cons_two]

@[simp] theorem isIndexPath_singleton_iff {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) (p : List I) :
    IsIndexPath [M] p ↔ p = [] := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp
    unfold IsIndexPath at h
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at h
    omega
  · rintro rfl
    rfl

@[simp] theorem isIndexPath_cons_two_iff {I : Type} (M N : ChannelMatrix I)
    (Ms : List (ChannelMatrix I)) (k : I) (p : List I) :
    IsIndexPath (M :: N :: Ms) (k :: p) ↔ IsIndexPath (N :: Ms) p := by
  unfold IsIndexPath
  simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
  omega

/-- In a canonically ordered semiring with no zero divisors, a path product
is positive exactly when all its factors are positive. -/
theorem pathWeight_pos_iff {I : Type} (Ms : List (ChannelMatrix I)) (i j : I) (p : List I) :
    0 < pathWeight Ms i j p ↔ ∀ a ∈ pathFactors Ms i j p, 0 < a := by
  simp only [pathWeight, pos_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, List.prod_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h a ha hzero
    apply h
    simpa [hzero] using ha
  · intro h hmem
    exact h 0 hmem rfl

/-- Zero-entry criterion for every nonempty ordered matrix product.  The
`n = 1` case is the singleton branch and uses the unique empty path. -/
theorem orderedMatrixProduct_entry_eq_zero_iff {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (Ms : List (ChannelMatrix I)) (hMs : Ms ≠ []) (i j : I) :
    channelEntry (orderedMatrixProduct Ms) i j = 0 ↔
      ∀ p : List I, IsIndexPath Ms p → pathWeight Ms i j p = 0 := by
  induction Ms generalizing i j with
  | nil => exact (hMs rfl).elim
  | cons M Ms ih =>
      cases Ms with
      | nil =>
          constructor
          · intro h p hp
            have hp' : p = [] := (isIndexPath_singleton_iff M p).mp hp
            subst p
            simpa using h
          · intro h
            have hp : IsIndexPath [M] [] := rfl
            simpa using h [] hp
      | cons N Ms =>
          have ih' := ih (List.cons_ne_nil N Ms)
          rw [orderedMatrixProduct_cons, channelEntry_mul]
          have hsum :
              (∑ k : I, channelEntry (orderedMatrixProduct (N :: Ms)) k j *
                channelEntry M i k) = 0 ↔
              ∀ k : I, channelEntry (orderedMatrixProduct (N :: Ms)) k j *
                channelEntry M i k = 0 := by
            constructor
            · intro h k
              exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
                (fun k _ => zero_le (channelEntry (orderedMatrixProduct (N :: Ms)) k j *
                  channelEntry M i k))).mp h k (Finset.mem_univ k)
            · intro h
              exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => h k
          rw [hsum]
          constructor
          · intro hterms p hp
            cases p with
            | nil => simp [IsIndexPath] at hp
            | cons k q =>
                have hq : IsIndexPath (N :: Ms) q :=
                  (isIndexPath_cons_two_iff M N Ms k q).mp hp
                rw [pathWeight_cons_two]
                have hterm := hterms k
                by_cases hM : channelEntry M i k = 0
                · rw [hM, zero_mul]
                · have hT : channelEntry (orderedMatrixProduct (N :: Ms)) k j = 0 := by
                    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hterm with hT | hM0
                    · exact hT
                    · exact (hM hM0).elim
                  have hq0 : pathWeight (N :: Ms) k j q = 0 :=
                    (ih' k j).mp hT q hq
                  simp [hq0]
          · intro hpaths k
            by_cases hM : channelEntry M i k = 0
            · rw [hM, mul_zero]
            · have hT : channelEntry (orderedMatrixProduct (N :: Ms)) k j = 0 := by
                apply (ih' k j).mpr
                intro q hq
                have hfull := hpaths (k :: q)
                  ((isIndexPath_cons_two_iff M N Ms k q).mpr hq)
                rw [pathWeight_cons_two] at hfull
                rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfull with hM0 | hq0
                · exact (hM hM0).elim
                · exact hq0
              rw [hT, zero_mul]

/-- Zero-entry criterion in the source's explicit form: every valid path
has at least one zero factor. -/
theorem orderedMatrixProduct_entry_eq_zero_iff_exists_zero_factor {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (Ms : List (ChannelMatrix I)) (hMs : Ms ≠ []) (i j : I) :
    channelEntry (orderedMatrixProduct Ms) i j = 0 ↔
      ∀ p : List I, IsIndexPath Ms p →
        ∃ a ∈ pathFactors Ms i j p, a = 0 := by
  rw [orderedMatrixProduct_entry_eq_zero_iff Ms hMs i j]
  constructor
  · intro h p hp
    have hz : pathWeight Ms i j p = 0 := h p hp
    have hmem : (0 : ENNReal) ∈ pathFactors Ms i j p := by
      rw [← List.prod_eq_zero_iff]
      exact hz
    exact ⟨0, hmem, rfl⟩
  · intro h p hp
    rcases h p hp with ⟨a, ha, ha0⟩
    rw [pathWeight, List.prod_eq_zero_iff]
    simpa [ha0] using ha

/-- Positive-entry criterion: a nonempty ordered product entry is strictly
positive exactly when at least one valid path has all entries positive. -/
theorem orderedMatrixProduct_entry_pos_iff {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (Ms : List (ChannelMatrix I)) (hMs : Ms ≠ []) (i j : I) :
    0 < channelEntry (orderedMatrixProduct Ms) i j ↔
      ∃ p : List I, IsAllPositivePath Ms i j p := by
  constructor
  · intro hpos
    have hne : channelEntry (orderedMatrixProduct Ms) i j ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpos
    have hnot : ¬ (∀ p : List I, IsIndexPath Ms p → pathWeight Ms i j p = 0) := by
      intro hzero
      exact hne ((orderedMatrixProduct_entry_eq_zero_iff Ms hMs i j).mpr hzero)
    push_neg at hnot
    rcases hnot with ⟨p, hp, hw⟩
    refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
    exact (pathWeight_pos_iff Ms i j p).mp (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hw)
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hall⟩
    have hw : 0 < pathWeight Ms i j p := (pathWeight_pos_iff Ms i j p).mpr hall
    apply pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro hentry
    have hzero := (orderedMatrixProduct_entry_eq_zero_iff Ms hMs i j).mp hentry
    exact (ne_of_gt hw) (hzero p hp)

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
```

```lean filename=formal_oet/vol_01/ch_02_operator_bounds/Basic.lean
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Mul
import Mathlib.Tactic
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.operator_space

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

universe u v

/-- HC02-D03.  A bound matrix is stored input first: `M i j` is the
coefficient from input component `i` to output component `j`. -/
abbrev BoundMatrix (I : Type u) := I → I → ENNReal

/-- HC02-D03.  The usual displayed matrix has output `j` as its row and
input `i` as its column. -/
def displayMatrix {I : Type u} (M : BoundMatrix I) : Matrix I I ENNReal :=
  fun j i => M i j

/-- Convert an ordinarily displayed matrix back to input-first storage. -/
def inputMatrix {I : Type u} (A : Matrix I I ENNReal) : BoundMatrix I :=
  fun i j => A j i

@[simp] theorem inputMatrix_displayMatrix {I : Type u} (M : BoundMatrix I) :
    inputMatrix (displayMatrix M) = M := rfl

@[simp] theorem displayMatrix_inputMatrix {I : Type u} (A : Matrix I I ENNReal) :
    displayMatrix (inputMatrix A) = A := rfl

/-- HC02-D03.  This is `(M₂ M₁) i j = ∑ k, M₂ k j * M₁ i k`. -/
noncomputable def boundMul {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (M₂ M₁ : BoundMatrix I) : BoundMatrix I :=
  fun i j => ∑ k : I, M₂ k j * M₁ i k

@[simp] theorem boundMul_apply {I : Type u} [Fintype I]
    (M₂ M₁ : BoundMatrix I) (i j : I) :
    boundMul M₂ M₁ i j = ∑ k : I, M₂ k j * M₁ i k := rfl

/-- HC02-D03: input-first multiplication is ordinary matrix multiplication
after exchanging rows and columns. -/
theorem displayMatrix_boundMul {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (M₂ M₁ : BoundMatrix I) :
    displayMatrix (boundMul M₂ M₁) = displayMatrix M₂ * displayMatrix M₁ := by
  ext j i
  simp [displayMatrix, boundMul, Matrix.mul_apply]

/-- HC02-D04.  The identity uses the Kronecker delta, with input index first. -/
noncomputable def boundIdentity {I : Type u} : BoundMatrix I := by
  classical
  exact fun i j => if i = j then 1 else 0

/-- HC02-D04.  The ordered product of `A 0, ..., A (n-1)` is
`A (n-1) * ... * A 0`; the empty product is the identity. -/
noncomputable def orderedProduct {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) :
    ℕ → BoundMatrix I
  | 0 => boundIdentity
  | n + 1 => boundMul (A n) (orderedProduct A n)

@[simp] theorem orderedProduct_zero {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) :
    orderedProduct A 0 = boundIdentity := rfl

/-- HC02-D01.  Restricted Lipschitz certificates.  Membership includes the
stated restriction-domain condition. -/
def IsRestrictedLip {X : Type} {I : Type u} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L : BoundMatrix I) : Prop :=
  U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ ∑ i : I, L i j * d i x y

/-- HC02-D01.  The family of restricted Lipschitz certificates. -/
def restrictedLipCertificates {X : Type} {I : Type u} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Set (BoundMatrix I) :=
  {L | IsRestrictedLip d ϕ U L}

/-- HC02-D01.  Global certificates are certificates on `dom ϕ`. -/
def lipCertificates {X : Type} {I : Type u} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) : Set (BoundMatrix I) :=
  restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ (dom ϕ)

/-- HC02-D02.  Restricted co-Lipschitz certificates, including nonemptiness
of the restriction domain as part of the definition. -/
def IsRestrictedCoLip {X : Type} {I : Type u} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (K : BoundMatrix I) : Prop :=
  U.Nonempty ∧ U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      (∑ i : I, K i j * d i x y) ≤ d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)

/-- HC02-D02.  The family of restricted co-Lipschitz certificates. -/
def restrictedCoLipCertificates {X : Type} {I : Type u} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Set (BoundMatrix I) :=
  {K | IsRestrictedCoLip d ϕ U K}

/-- HC02-D02.  Global co-Lipschitz certificates use `dom ϕ`; in particular,
this family is defined only when that domain is nonempty. -/
def coLipCertificates {X : Type} {I : Type u} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) : Set (BoundMatrix I) :=
  restrictedCoLipCertificates d ϕ (dom ϕ)

/-- HC02-P04.  Entrywise infimum over a family of matrix certificates. -/
noncomputable def entryInf {X : Type} {I : Type u} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i j : I) : ENNReal :=
  sInf ((fun L : BoundMatrix I => L i j) '' restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ U)

/-- HC02-D07.  A component channel is an input/output pair. -/
abbrev ComponentChannel (I : Type u) := I × I

/-- HC02-D07.  In output row `j`, only input position `i` may be nonzero. -/
def RowSparse {I : Type u} (L : BoundMatrix I) (i j : I) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : I, k ≠ i → L k j = 0

/-- HC02-D07.  Existence of a single supporting input in output row `j`. -/
def RowDecoupled {I : Type u} (L : BoundMatrix I) (j : I) : Prop :=
  ∃ i : I, RowSparse L i j

/-- HC02-D07.  In input column `i`, only output position `j` may be nonzero. -/
def ColumnSparse {I : Type u} (L : BoundMatrix I) (i j : I) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : I, k ≠ j → L i k = 0

/-- HC02-D07.  Existence of a single supporting output in input column `i`. -/
def ColumnDecoupled {I : Type u} (L : BoundMatrix I) (i : I) : Prop :=
  ∃ j : I, ColumnSparse L i j

/-- HC02-D07.  A completely decoupled certificate is diagonal. -/
def Diagonal {I : Type u} (L : BoundMatrix I) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I, i ≠ j → L i j = 0

/-- HC02-D08.  Feasible scalar constants for one component channel. -/
def scalarFeasible {X : Type} {I : Type u} {bot : X}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i j : I) : Set ENNReal :=
  {lam | ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ lam * d i x y}

/-- HC02-D08.  The optimal single-channel constant.  In `ENNReal`,
`sInf ∅ = ∞`, exactly as required by the text. -/
noncomputable def channelLip {X : Type} {I : Type u} {bot : X}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i j : I) : ENNReal :=
  sInf (scalarFeasible d ϕ U i j)

/-- HC02-D05.  The actual input domain after zero steps is `U`; after the
next step it is the image under that step. -/
def actualDomain {X : Type} {bot : X} (U : Set X)
    (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot) : ℕ → Set X
  | 0 => U
  | n + 1 => (ϕ n).func '' actualDomain U ϕ n

/-- HC02-D04/D05.  The finite operator chain in application order. -/
def operatorChain {X : Type} {bot : X} (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot) :
    ℕ → Operator X bot
  | 0 => OperatorChain []
  | n + 1 => OperatorChain [ϕ n, operatorChain ϕ n]

/-- HC02-D05.  Every local Lip bound is imposed on the actual input domain
of its own step; no final-composite bound occurs in this predicate. -/
def LipChainValid {X : Type} {I : Type u} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (L : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) : ℕ → Prop
  | 0 => True
  | n + 1 => LipChainValid d U ϕ L n ∧
      L n ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d (ϕ n) (actualDomain U ϕ n)

/-- HC02-D05.  The analogous local co-Lip chain data. -/
def CoLipChainValid {X : Type} {I : Type u} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (K : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) : ℕ → Prop
  | 0 => True
  | n + 1 => CoLipChainValid d U ϕ K n ∧
      K n ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d (ϕ n) (actualDomain U ϕ n)

/-- HC02-D06.  Complete finite index paths.  `single` is the unique empty
intermediate sequence at length one.  `snoc` appends one final edge; the old
terminal index becomes the last intermediate index. -/
inductive IndexPath (I : Type u) : ℕ → I → I → Type u where
  | single (i j : I) : IndexPath I 1 i j
  | snoc {n : ℕ} {i k : I} (p : IndexPath I n i k) (j : I) : IndexPath I (n + 1) i j

namespace IndexPath

/-- HC02-D06.  The intermediate index sequence `(k₁,...,k_{n-1})`. -/
def intermediate {I : Type u} {n : ℕ} {i j : I} : IndexPath I n i j → List I
  | .single _ _ => []
  | .snoc (k := k) p _ => intermediate p ++ [k]

/-- HC02-D06.  The path weight, namely the product of its edge entries in
application order. -/
noncomputable def weight {I : Type u} (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) {n : ℕ} {i j : I} :
    IndexPath I n i j → ENNReal
  | .single i j => A 0 i j
  | .snoc (n := n) (k := k) p j => weight A p * A n k j

/-- HC02-D06.  Every edge on the path is strictly positive. -/
def AllPositive {I : Type u} (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) {n : ℕ} {i j : I} :
    IndexPath I n i j → Prop
  | .single i j => 0 < A 0 i j
  | .snoc (n := n) (k := k) p j => AllPositive A p ∧ 0 < A n k j

/-- HC02-D06.  At least one edge on the path is zero. -/
def HasZero {I : Type u} (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) {n : ℕ} {i j : I} :
    IndexPath I n i j → Prop
  | .single i j => A 0 i j = 0
  | .snoc (n := n) (k := k) p j => HasZero A p ∨ A n k j = 0

end IndexPath
```

```lean filename=formal_oet/vol_01/ch_02_operator_bounds/Bounds.lean
@[simp] theorem boundIdentity_apply {I : Type u} (i j : I) :
    boundIdentity i j = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  rfl

/-- HC02-D04.  Right identity for input-first multiplication. -/
theorem boundMul_identity_right {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (M : BoundMatrix I) :
    boundMul M boundIdentity = M := by
  classical
  ext i j
  simp [boundMul, boundIdentity]

/-- HC02-D04.  Left identity for input-first multiplication. -/
theorem boundMul_identity_left {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (M : BoundMatrix I) :
    boundMul boundIdentity M = M := by
  classical
  ext i j
  simp [boundMul, boundIdentity]

/-- HC02-D04.  A one-step ordered product is its unique matrix. -/
@[simp] theorem orderedProduct_one {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) :
    orderedProduct A 1 = A 0 := by
  exact boundMul_identity_right (A 0)

@[simp] theorem identity_bound_sum {I X : Type} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (x y : X) (j : I) :
    (∑ i : I, boundIdentity i j * d i x y) = d j x y := by
  classical
  simp [boundIdentity]

/-- HC02-P14.  The identity matrix is a Lip certificate for the empty
operator chain. -/
theorem identity_lip {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (hU : U ⊆ dom (OperatorChain ([] : List (Operator X bot)))) :
    boundIdentity ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d (OperatorChain ([] : List (Operator X bot))) U := by
  refine ⟨hU, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  change d j x y ≤ ∑ i : I, boundIdentity i j * d i x y
  exact (identity_bound_sum d x y j).ge

/-- HC02-P15.  On the same nonempty legal domain, the identity matrix is
also a co-Lip certificate. -/
theorem identity_coLip {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) (hUne : U.Nonempty)
    (hU : U ⊆ dom (OperatorChain ([] : List (Operator X bot)))) :
    boundIdentity ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d (OperatorChain ([] : List (Operator X bot))) U := by
  refine ⟨hUne, hU, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  change (∑ i : I, boundIdentity i j * d i x y) ≤ d j x y
  exact (identity_bound_sum d x y j).le

/-- HC02-P01.  On a singleton index type the matrix condition is exactly
the displayed scalar inequality. -/
theorem lip_unique {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I] [Unique I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (L : BoundMatrix I) :
    L ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ U ↔
      U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
        d default (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ L default default * d default x y := by
  constructor
  · intro hL
    refine ⟨hL.1, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    simpa using hL.2 x hx y hy default
  · rintro ⟨hU, hscalar⟩
    refine ⟨hU, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy j
    have hj : j = default := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst j
    simpa using hscalar x hx y hy

/-- The same singleton degeneration with an explicitly named unique index. -/
theorem lip_singleton {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (L : BoundMatrix I)
    (i₀ : I) (hI : ∀ k : I, k = i₀) :
    L ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ U ↔
      U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
        d i₀ (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ L i₀ i₀ * d i₀ x y := by
  letI : Unique I := { toInhabited := ⟨i₀⟩, uniq := hI }
  exact lip_unique d ϕ U L

/-- HC02-P02.  A global Lip certificate restricts to every legal subset. -/
theorem lip_global_subset_restricted {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (hU : U ⊆ dom ϕ) :
    lipCertificates d ϕ ⊆ restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ U := by
  intro L hL
  exact ⟨hU, fun x hx y hy j => hL.2 x (hU hx) y (hU hy) j⟩

/-- HC02-P03.  Shrinking the evaluation domain enlarges the certificate family. -/
theorem restrictedLip_mono {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) {U V : Set X}
    (hUV : U ⊆ V) :
    restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ V ⊆ restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ U := by
  intro L hL
  exact ⟨hUV.trans hL.1, fun x hx y hy j => hL.2 x (hUV hx) y (hUV hy) j⟩

/-- HC02-P04.  Entrywise infima do not increase when the evaluation domain
is enlarged. -/
theorem entryInf_mono {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) {U V : Set X}
    (hUV : U ⊆ V) (i j : I) :
    entryInf d ϕ U i j ≤ entryInf d ϕ V i j := by
  apply sInf_le_sInf
  exact Set.image_mono (restrictedLip_mono d ϕ hUV)

/-- The extended-nonnegative-real finite-sum calculation shared by the Lip
and co-Lip composition laws. -/
theorem weighted_sum_exchange {I : Type u} [Fintype I]
    (M₂ M₁ : BoundMatrix I) (w : I → ENNReal) (j : I) :
    (∑ k : I, M₂ k j * (∑ i : I, M₁ i k * w i)) =
      ∑ i : I, boundMul M₂ M₁ i j * w i := by
  classical
  simp_rw [boundMul, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

/-- HC02-P05.  Two-step Lipschitz composition on the actual intermediate
image domain. -/
theorem lip_comp_two {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X)
    (L₁ L₂ : BoundMatrix I)
    (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁]))
    (hL₁ : L₁ ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ₁ U₁)
    (hL₂ : L₂ ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ₂ (ϕ₁.func '' U₁)) :
    boundMul L₂ L₁ ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d (OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁]) U₁ := by
  refine ⟨hU₁, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  change d j (ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func x)) (ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func y)) ≤
    ∑ i : I, boundMul L₂ L₁ i j * d i x y
  calc
    d j (ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func x)) (ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func y)) ≤
        ∑ k : I, L₂ k j * d k (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) :=
      hL₂.2 (ϕ₁.func x) ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ (ϕ₁.func y) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ j
    _ ≤ ∑ k : I, L₂ k j * (∑ i : I, L₁ i k * d i x y) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k hk
      exact mul_le_mul_left' (hL₁.2 x hx y hy k) _
    _ = ∑ i : I, boundMul L₂ L₁ i j * d i x y :=
      weighted_sum_exchange L₂ L₁ (fun i => d i x y) j

/-- HC02-P07.  Two-step co-Lipschitz composition on the actual intermediate
image domain. -/
theorem coLip_comp_two {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X)
    (K₁ K₂ : BoundMatrix I)
    (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁]))
    (hK₁ : K₁ ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d ϕ₁ U₁)
    (hK₂ : K₂ ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d ϕ₂ (ϕ₁.func '' U₁)) :
    boundMul K₂ K₁ ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d (OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁]) U₁ := by
  refine ⟨hK₁.1, hU₁, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  change (∑ i : I, boundMul K₂ K₁ i j * d i x y) ≤
    d j (ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func x)) (ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func y))
  calc
    (∑ i : I, boundMul K₂ K₁ i j * d i x y) =
        ∑ k : I, K₂ k j * (∑ i : I, K₁ i k * d i x y) :=
      (weighted_sum_exchange K₂ K₁ (fun i => d i x y) j).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ k : I, K₂ k j * d k (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k hk
      exact mul_le_mul_left' (hK₁.2.2 x hx y hy k) _
    _ ≤ d j (ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func x)) (ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func y)) :=
      hK₂.2.2 (ϕ₁.func x) ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ (ϕ₁.func y) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ j

/-- HC02-P06.  A zero output distance together with positive input distance
forces the corresponding global co-Lip entry to vanish. -/
theorem coLip_entry_eq_zero_of_output_zero {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (K : BoundMatrix I)
    (hK : K ∈ coLipCertificates d ϕ) (x y : X) (hx : x ∈ dom ϕ) (hy : y ∈ dom ϕ)
    (i j : I) (hout : d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0) (hin : 0 < d i x y) :
    K i j = 0 := by
  have hsum : (∑ k : I, K k j * d k x y) = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · simpa [hout] using hK.2.2 x hx y hy j
    · exact zero_le _
  have hterm_le : K i j * d i x y ≤ ∑ k : I, K k j * d k x y := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => zero_le (K k j * d k x y)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hterm : K i j * d i x y = 0 :=
    le_antisymm (hterm_le.trans_eq hsum) (zero_le _)
  by_contra hKne
  have hpos : 0 < K i j * d i x y := ENNReal.mul_pos hKne hin.ne'
  rw [hterm] at hpos
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) hpos

/-- HC02-P08.  Forward point-pair image-distance perturbation. -/
theorem perturbation_forward {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ i : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d i))
    (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (δ : I → ENNReal)
    (hδ : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : I, d j (ϕ₁.func z) (ϕ₂.func z) ≤ δ j)
    (x y : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) (j : I) :
    d j (ϕ₂.func x) (ϕ₂.func y) ≤
      d j (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) + δ j + δ j := by
  have hδrev : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : I, d j (ϕ₂.func z) (ϕ₁.func z) ≤ δ j := by
    intro z hz k
    rw [(hd k).symm (ϕ₂.func z) (ϕ₁.func z)]
    exact hδ z hz k
  calc
    d j (ϕ₂.func x) (ϕ₂.func y) ≤
        d j (ϕ₂.func x) (ϕ₁.func x) + d j (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₂.func y) :=
      (hd j).triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ d j (ϕ₂.func x) (ϕ₁.func x) +
        (d j (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) + d j (ϕ₁.func y) (ϕ₂.func y)) :=
      add_le_add (le_refl _) ((hd j).triangle _ _ _)
    _ ≤ δ j + (d j (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) + δ j) :=
      add_le_add (hδrev x hx j) (add_le_add (le_refl _) (hδ y hy j))
    _ = d j (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) + δ j + δ j := by
      rw [← add_assoc, add_comm (δ j) (d j (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y)), add_assoc]

/-- HC02-P09.  The reverse point-pair perturbation follows by symmetry. -/
theorem perturbation_reverse {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ i : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d i))
    (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (δ : I → ENNReal)
    (hδ : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : I, d j (ϕ₁.func z) (ϕ₂.func z) ≤ δ j)
    (x y : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) (j : I) :
    d j (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) ≤
      d j (ϕ₂.func x) (ϕ₂.func y) + δ j + δ j := by
  apply perturbation_forward d hd ϕ₂ ϕ₁ U δ
  · intro z hz k
    rw [(hd k).symm (ϕ₂.func z) (ϕ₁.func z)]
    exact hδ z hz k
  · exact hx
  · exact hy

/-- HC02-P10.  Additive perturbation of a Lip upper bound. -/
theorem perturbation_lip {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ i : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d i))
    (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (δ : I → ENNReal) (L₁ : BoundMatrix I)
    (hδ : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : I, d j (ϕ₁.func z) (ϕ₂.func z) ≤ δ j)
    (hL₁ : L₁ ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ₁ U)
    (x y : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) (j : I) :
    d j (ϕ₂.func x) (ϕ₂.func y) ≤
      (∑ i : I, L₁ i j * d i x y) + 2 * δ j := by
  calc
    d j (ϕ₂.func x) (ϕ₂.func y) ≤
        d j (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) + δ j + δ j :=
      perturbation_forward d hd ϕ₁ ϕ₂ U δ hδ x y hx hy j
    _ ≤ (∑ i : I, L₁ i j * d i x y) + δ j + δ j := by
      exact add_le_add (add_le_add (hL₁.2 x hx y hy j) (le_refl _)) (le_refl _)
    _ = (∑ i : I, L₁ i j * d i x y) + 2 * δ j := by rw [two_mul]; ac_rfl

/-- HC02-P11.  Additive perturbation of a co-Lip lower bound. -/
theorem perturbation_coLip {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ i : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d i))
    (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (δ : I → ENNReal) (K₁ : BoundMatrix I)
    (hδ : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : I, d j (ϕ₁.func z) (ϕ₂.func z) ≤ δ j)
    (hK₁ : K₁ ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d ϕ₁ U)
    (x y : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) (j : I) :
    (∑ i : I, K₁ i j * d i x y) ≤
      d j (ϕ₂.func x) (ϕ₂.func y) + 2 * δ j := by
  calc
    (∑ i : I, K₁ i j * d i x y) ≤ d j (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) :=
      hK₁.2.2 x hx y hy j
    _ ≤ d j (ϕ₂.func x) (ϕ₂.func y) + δ j + δ j :=
      perturbation_reverse d hd ϕ₁ ϕ₂ U δ hδ x y hx hy j
    _ = d j (ϕ₂.func x) (ϕ₂.func y) + 2 * δ j := by rw [two_mul]; ac_rfl

/-- HC02-P25.  A zero matrix coefficient removes its own summand, including
when the corresponding distance is infinite. -/
theorem zero_coefficient_term {I X : Type} (L : BoundMatrix I)
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (i j : I) (x y : X) (hzero : L i j = 0) :
    L i j * d i x y = 0 := by simp [hzero]

/-- HC02-P25.  The zero input position can be deleted from the finite sum. -/
theorem sum_erase_of_coefficient_zero {I X : Type} [Fintype I]
    (L : BoundMatrix I) (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (i j : I) (x y : X)
    (hzero : L i j = 0) :
    (∑ k : I, L k j * d k x y) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, L k j * d k x y := by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  simp [hzero]

/-- HC02-P26.  A single supported input position simplifies an output row. -/
theorem lip_row_sparse {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (L : BoundMatrix I)
    (hL : L ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ U) {i j : I}
    (hrow : RowSparse L i j) (x y : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ L i j * d i x y := by
  refine (hL.2 x hx y hy j).trans_eq ?_
  classical
  apply Finset.sum_eq_single i
  · intro k hk hki
    simp [hrow k hki]
  · simp

/-- HC02-P27.  A singly supported input column can contribute only to its
designated output position. -/
theorem column_sparse_terms_zero {I X : Type}
    (L : BoundMatrix I) (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) {i j : I}
    (hcol : ColumnSparse L i j) (x y : X) :
    ∀ k : I, k ≠ j → L i k * d i x y = 0 := by
  intro k hk
  simp [hcol k hk]

/-- HC02-P28.  A diagonal Lip certificate gives scalar bounds on every
component. -/
theorem diagonal_lip_bounds {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (L : BoundMatrix I)
    (hL : L ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ U) (hdiag : Diagonal L)
    (x y : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) (j : I) :
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ L j j * d j x y := by
  exact lip_row_sparse d ϕ U L hL (fun k hkj => hdiag k j hkj) x y hx hy

/-- HC02-P29.  Only row sparsity of the Lip certificate is needed for the
scalar two-sided bound; no sparsity assumption is made on `K`. -/
theorem diagonal_input_two_sided {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L K : BoundMatrix I)
    (hL : L ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ U)
    (hK : K ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d ϕ U) {j : I}
    (hrow : ∀ k : I, k ≠ j → L k j = 0)
    (x y : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    K j j * d j x y ≤ d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ∧
      d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ L j j * d j x y := by
  constructor
  · calc
      K j j * d j x y ≤ ∑ k : I, K k j * d k x y := by
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => zero_le (K k j * d k x y)) (Finset.mem_univ j)
      _ ≤ d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) := hK.2.2 x hx y hy j
  · exact lip_row_sparse d ϕ U L hL hrow x y hx hy

/-- HC02-P30.  Componentwise two-sided bounds, including the finite-diagonal
coefficient branch. -/
theorem all_components_two_sided_finite {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L K : BoundMatrix I)
    (hL : L ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d ϕ U)
    (hK : K ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d ϕ U)
    (hrows : ∀ j k : I, k ≠ j → L k j = 0)
    (hfinite : ∀ j : I, L j j < ∞ ∧ K j j < ∞) :
    ∀ j : I, K j j < ∞ ∧ L j j < ∞ ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
        K j j * d j x y ≤ d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ∧
          d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ L j j * d j x y := by
  intro j
  exact ⟨(hfinite j).2, (hfinite j).1,
    fun x hx y hy => diagonal_input_two_sided d ϕ U L K hL hK (hrows j) x y hx hy⟩

/-- HC02-P31.  A positive co-Lip channel preserves distinguishability. -/
theorem positive_coLip_channel {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (K : BoundMatrix I)
    (hK : K ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d ϕ U) {i j : I}
    (hKpos : 0 < K i j) (x y : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hdist : 0 < d i x y) :
    0 < d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) := by
  have hterm : K i j * d i x y ≤ ∑ k : I, K k j * d k x y := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => zero_le (K k j * d k x y)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hpos : 0 < K i j * d i x y := ENNReal.mul_pos hKpos.ne' hdist.ne'
  exact hpos.trans_le (hterm.trans (hK.2.2 x hx y hy j))

/-- HC02-P32.  Positive diagonal co-Lip channels reflect the family zero
relation. -/
theorem positive_diagonal_coLip_reflects {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (K : BoundMatrix I)
    (hK : K ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d ϕ U)
    (hdiag : ∀ j : I, 0 < K j j) (x y : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hzero : GaugeZeroRelated d (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)) :
    GaugeZeroRelated d x y := by
  intro j
  by_contra hj
  have hpos : 0 < d j x y := pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hj
  have hout := positive_coLip_channel d ϕ U K hK (hdiag j) x y hx hy hpos
  exact hout.ne' (hzero j)

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
```

```lean filename=formal_oet/vol_01/ch_02_operator_bounds/Chains.lean
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.Bounds

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

open scoped BigOperators ENNReal Classical
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

/-- A legal pair composite has a legal first stage. -/
theorem dom_of_chain_two_left {X : Type} {bot : X}
    (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (h : U ⊆ dom (OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁])) : U ⊆ dom ϕ₁ := by
  intro x hx hfirst
  have hcomp := h hx
  apply hcomp
  change ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func x) = bot
  rw [hfirst, ϕ₂.preserves_bot]

/-- A legal pair composite has a legal second stage on the actual image. -/
theorem image_sub_dom_chain_two_right {X : Type} {bot : X}
    (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (h : U ⊆ dom (OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁])) : ϕ₁.func '' U ⊆ dom ϕ₂ := by
  intro z hz
  rcases hz with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact h hx

/-- HC02-D05.  The image of the whole composite is exactly the recursively
computed actual domain. -/
theorem operatorChain_image {X : Type} {bot : X} (U : Set X)
    (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot) (n : ℕ) :
    (operatorChain ϕ n).func '' U = actualDomain U ϕ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp [operatorChain, actualDomain, OperatorChain]
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        (operatorChain ϕ (n + 1)).func '' U =
            ((ϕ n).func ∘ (operatorChain ϕ n).func) '' U := rfl
        _ = (ϕ n).func '' ((operatorChain ϕ n).func '' U) := Set.image_comp _ _ _
        _ = actualDomain U ϕ (n + 1) := by rw [ih]; rfl

/-- HC02-D05.  Iterated images are nonempty exactly when the initial set is. -/
theorem actualDomain_nonempty_iff {X : Type} {bot : X} (U : Set X)
    (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot) (n : ℕ) :
    (actualDomain U ϕ n).Nonempty ↔ U.Nonempty := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [actualDomain, ih]

/-- HC02-D05.  Legality of the full composite implies legality of every
individual step on its actual input domain. -/
theorem actualDomain_subset_dom {X : Type} {bot : X} (U : Set X)
    (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot) {n m : ℕ} (hm : m < n)
    (hdom : U ⊆ dom (operatorChain ϕ n)) :
    actualDomain U ϕ m ⊆ dom (ϕ m) := by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hmn : m = n
      · subst m
        rw [← operatorChain_image]
        exact image_sub_dom_chain_two_right (operatorChain ϕ n) (ϕ n) U hdom
      · apply ih (m := m) (by omega)
        exact dom_of_chain_two_left (operatorChain ϕ n) (ϕ n) U hdom

/-- HC02-D05.  Extract any one local Lip certificate from the recursively
specified chain data. -/
theorem LipChainValid.step {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (L : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) {n m : ℕ} (hm : m < n)
    (hvalid : LipChainValid d U ϕ L n) :
    L m ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d (ϕ m) (actualDomain U ϕ m) := by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hmn : m = n
      · subst m
        exact hvalid.2
      · exact ih (m := m) (by omega) hvalid.1

/-- HC02-D05.  Extract any one local co-Lip certificate from the recursively
specified chain data. -/
theorem CoLipChainValid.step {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (K : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) {n m : ℕ} (hm : m < n)
    (hvalid : CoLipChainValid d U ϕ K n) :
    K m ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d (ϕ m) (actualDomain U ϕ m) := by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hmn : m = n
      · subst m
        exact hvalid.2
      · exact ih (m := m) (by omega) hvalid.1

/-- HC02-P12.  The specified ordered product of local Lip certificates is a
certificate for the full finite chain. -/
theorem lip_orderedProduct_chain {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (L : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) (n : ℕ)
    (hdom : U ⊆ dom (operatorChain ϕ n))
    (hvalid : LipChainValid d U ϕ L n) :
    orderedProduct L n ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d (operatorChain ϕ n) U := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact identity_lip d U hdom
  | succ n ih =>
      have hprefix : U ⊆ dom (operatorChain ϕ n) :=
        dom_of_chain_two_left (operatorChain ϕ n) (ϕ n) U hdom
      have hproduct := ih hprefix hvalid.1
      have hlast : L n ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d (ϕ n)
          ((operatorChain ϕ n).func '' U) := by
        rw [operatorChain_image]
        exact hvalid.2
      exact lip_comp_two d (operatorChain ϕ n) (ϕ n) U
        (orderedProduct L n) (L n) hdom hproduct hlast

/-- The co-Lip chain induction with an explicit nonempty initial domain. -/
theorem coLip_orderedProduct_chain_aux {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (K : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) (hU : U.Nonempty) (n : ℕ)
    (hdom : U ⊆ dom (operatorChain ϕ n))
    (hvalid : CoLipChainValid d U ϕ K n) :
    orderedProduct K n ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d (operatorChain ϕ n) U := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact identity_coLip d U hU hdom
  | succ n ih =>
      have hprefix : U ⊆ dom (operatorChain ϕ n) :=
        dom_of_chain_two_left (operatorChain ϕ n) (ϕ n) U hdom
      have hproduct := ih hprefix hvalid.1
      have hlast : K n ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d (ϕ n)
          ((operatorChain ϕ n).func '' U) := by
        rw [operatorChain_image]
        exact hvalid.2
      exact coLip_comp_two d (operatorChain ϕ n) (ϕ n) U
        (orderedProduct K n) (K n) hdom hproduct hlast

/-- HC02-P13.  Positive-length co-Lip chain.  Nonemptiness of `U` is derived
from the final local certificate, not added as an extra hypothesis. -/
theorem coLip_orderedProduct_chain_succ {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (K : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) (n : ℕ)
    (hdom : U ⊆ dom (operatorChain ϕ (n + 1)))
    (hvalid : CoLipChainValid d U ϕ K (n + 1)) :
    orderedProduct K (n + 1) ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d (operatorChain ϕ (n + 1)) U := by
  apply coLip_orderedProduct_chain_aux d U ϕ K _ (n + 1) hdom hvalid
  have himage : (actualDomain U ϕ n).Nonempty := hvalid.2.1
  exact (actualDomain_nonempty_iff U ϕ n).mp himage

/-- HC02-P14.  Zero-step unit Lip certificate in ordered-product notation. -/
theorem zero_step_unit_lip {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (L : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) (hU : U ⊆ dom (operatorChain ϕ 0)) :
    orderedProduct L 0 ∈ restrictedLipCertificates d (operatorChain ϕ 0) U := by
  exact identity_lip d U hU

/-- HC02-P15.  Zero-step unit co-Lip certificate in ordered-product notation. -/
theorem zero_step_unit_coLip {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (K : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) (hUne : U.Nonempty)
    (hU : U ⊆ dom (operatorChain ϕ 0)) :
    orderedProduct K 0 ∈ restrictedCoLipCertificates d (operatorChain ϕ 0) U := by
  exact identity_coLip d U hUne hU

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
```

```lean filename=formal_oet/vol_01/ch_02_operator_bounds/Paths.lean
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.Chains

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

open scoped BigOperators ENNReal Classical
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

namespace IndexPath

/-- Every path in this representation has positive edge length. -/
theorem length_pos {I : Type} {n : ℕ} {i j : I} (p : IndexPath I n i j) : 0 < n := by
  cases p <;> omega

/-- HC02-D06.  The intermediate list has exactly `n - 1` entries. -/
theorem intermediate_length {I : Type} {n : ℕ} {i j : I} (p : IndexPath I n i j) :
    p.intermediate.length = n - 1 := by
  induction p with
  | single => rfl
  | @snoc n i k p j ih =>
      have hn := length_pos p
      simp only [IndexPath.intermediate, List.length_append, List.length_singleton, ih]
      omega

/-- At length one, the only path is the empty-intermediate-sequence path. -/
theorem eq_single {I : Type} {i j : I} (p : IndexPath I 1 i j) :
    p = IndexPath.single i j := by
  cases p with
  | single => rfl
  | snoc p j => cases p

/-- HC02-D06.  The product weight vanishes exactly when the path has a zero edge. -/
theorem weight_eq_zero_iff {I : Type} (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) {n : ℕ} {i j : I}
    (p : IndexPath I n i j) : p.weight A = 0 ↔ p.HasZero A := by
  induction p with
  | single => rfl
  | snoc p j ih => simp [IndexPath.weight, IndexPath.HasZero, ih, mul_eq_zero]

/-- HC02-D06.  The product weight is positive exactly when every edge is positive. -/
theorem weight_pos_iff {I : Type} (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) {n : ℕ} {i j : I}
    (p : IndexPath I n i j) : 0 < p.weight A ↔ p.AllPositive A := by
  induction p with
  | single => rfl
  | snoc p j ih => simp [IndexPath.weight, IndexPath.AllPositive, ih, ENNReal.mul_pos_iff]

/-- Having a zero edge is the negation of being an all-positive path. -/
theorem hasZero_iff_not_allPositive {I : Type} (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) {n : ℕ} {i j : I}
    (p : IndexPath I n i j) : p.HasZero A ↔ ¬ p.AllPositive A := by
  rw [← weight_eq_zero_iff, ← weight_pos_iff]
  simp [pos_iff_ne_zero]

end IndexPath

/-- A positive ordered-product entry supplies a complete all-positive path. -/
theorem exists_allPositive_path_of_orderedProduct_pos {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) (n : ℕ) (i j : I)
    (h : 0 < orderedProduct A (n + 1) i j) :
    ∃ p : IndexPath I (n + 1) i j, p.AllPositive A := by
  induction n generalizing i j with
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨IndexPath.single i j, by simpa using h⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      change 0 < ∑ k : I, A (n + 1) k j * orderedProduct A (n + 1) i k at h
      have hex : ∃ k : I, 0 < A (n + 1) k j * orderedProduct A (n + 1) i k := by
        simpa using (Finset.sum_pos_iff.mp h)
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hex
      have hparts := ENNReal.mul_pos_iff.mp hk
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ih i k hparts.2
      exact ⟨IndexPath.snoc p j, hp, hparts.1⟩

/-- Every all-positive path forces the corresponding ordered-product entry
to be positive. -/
theorem orderedProduct_pos_of_allPositive_path {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) {n : ℕ} {i j : I}
    (p : IndexPath I n i j) (hp : p.AllPositive A) :
    0 < orderedProduct A n i j := by
  induction p with
  | single i j => simpa using hp
  | @snoc n i k p j ih =>
      change 0 < ∑ l : I, A n l j * orderedProduct A n i l
      apply Finset.sum_pos_iff.mpr
      refine ⟨k, Finset.mem_univ k, ?_⟩
      exact ENNReal.mul_pos_iff.mpr ⟨hp.2, ih hp.1⟩

/-- HC02-P17, algebraic form.  Positivity of an ordered-product entry is
equivalent to existence of one all-positive complete path. -/
theorem orderedProduct_pos_iff {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) (n : ℕ) (i j : I) :
    0 < orderedProduct A (n + 1) i j ↔
      ∃ p : IndexPath I (n + 1) i j, p.AllPositive A := by
  constructor
  · exact exists_allPositive_path_of_orderedProduct_pos A n i j
  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    exact orderedProduct_pos_of_allPositive_path A p hp

/-- HC02-P16, algebraic form.  Vanishing is equivalent to every complete
path containing at least one zero edge. -/
theorem orderedProduct_zero_iff {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) (n : ℕ) (i j : I) :
    orderedProduct A (n + 1) i j = 0 ↔
      ∀ p : IndexPath I (n + 1) i j, p.HasZero A := by
  constructor
  · intro h p
    apply (IndexPath.hasZero_iff_not_allPositive A p).mpr
    intro hp
    have hpos := (orderedProduct_pos_iff A n i j).mpr ⟨p, hp⟩
    rw [h] at hpos
    exact (lt_irrefl 0) hpos
  · intro h
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (orderedProduct_pos_iff A n i j).mp (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne)
    have hz := h p
    exact (IndexPath.hasZero_iff_not_allPositive A p).mp hz hp

/-- The `n = 1` zero criterion is the unique matrix entry itself. -/
theorem orderedProduct_one_zero_iff {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) (i j : I) :
    A 0 i j = 0 ↔ ∀ p : IndexPath I 1 i j, p.HasZero A := by
  simpa using orderedProduct_zero_iff A 0 i j

/-- The `n = 1` positive criterion is the unique matrix entry itself. -/
theorem orderedProduct_one_pos_iff {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (A : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) (i j : I) :
    0 < A 0 i j ↔ ∃ p : IndexPath I 1 i j, p.AllPositive A := by
  simpa using orderedProduct_pos_iff A 0 i j

/-- HC02-P16.  The zero-entry criterion in the same nonempty Lip-chain
context as the text. -/
theorem lip_chain_product_zero_iff {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (L : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) (n : ℕ)
    (_hdom : U ⊆ dom (operatorChain ϕ (n + 1)))
    (_hvalid : LipChainValid d U ϕ L (n + 1)) (i j : I) :
    orderedProduct L (n + 1) i j = 0 ↔
      ∀ p : IndexPath I (n + 1) i j, p.HasZero L := by
  exact orderedProduct_zero_iff L n i j

/-- HC02-P17.  The positive-entry criterion in the same nonempty co-Lip-chain
context as the text. -/
theorem coLip_chain_product_pos_iff {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (K : ℕ → BoundMatrix I) (n : ℕ)
    (_hdom : U ⊆ dom (operatorChain ϕ (n + 1)))
    (_hvalid : CoLipChainValid d U ϕ K (n + 1)) (i j : I) :
    0 < orderedProduct K (n + 1) i j ↔
      ∃ p : IndexPath I (n + 1) i j, p.AllPositive K := by
  exact orderedProduct_pos_iff K n i j

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
```
